one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented run_tasks using asyncio.gather, which does not wait for child task cleanup (finally blocks) to complete upon cancellation, violating the task's requirement for guaranteed cleanup on interruption.
t_commit_evidence: Step 1 includes task_complete: true alongside the cat heredoc command that creates /app/run.py with the flawed asyncio.gather implementation, locking in the wrong solution immediately.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks knowledge of the behavioral difference between asyncio.gather and asyncio.TaskGroup with respect to cancellation: gather propagates CancelledError without waiting for child tasks' finally/cleanup blocks to run, whereas TaskGroup ensures all tasks are fully joined before the block exits.
